en_US: This is odd... I heard there were two
caves on Route 206.
But I can only find one entrance.
Eterna City
Oreburgh City
Ah ha. Bonjour, Champ.
Just who I have been waiting for!
Route 206 is our newest promotional
area.
If you defeat all the trainers here,
I will give you either a Wide Lens
or 5 Charti Berries.
But wait, I have more bonne nouvelle.
The SBC has its first Sinnoh Recruit!
He’s a bit... erm how should I put this?
He lacks the certain... je ne sais
quoi that the SBC expects.
I will have to show him the way before
we present him to Lady Jacinthe.
But, this means we can do all new
types of promotion.
In fact there is one up at Wayward
Cave just east and north of here,
under the Cycling Road.
Be sure to give it a challenge
and remember to come see me once
you have beaten all the trainers here.
Good luck, Champ.
Chapeau! It seems that you have
defeated every trainer on Route 206!
Here is your reward as promised.
Would you like the Wide Lens or
5 Charti Berries?
Don’t forget to try out the new
promotion if you haven’t alredy.
We’ll be moving on to Route 209
next.

’Sup, Chump?
The name’s Roy.
I’m the newest member of the Society
of Battle Cono... Connas...
The Battle Society!
Not enough people were battling, so
we turned this boring cave into a
Skirmish Zone.
What’s a Skirmish Zone you ask?
Julien didn’t trust me to explain
the rules so there’s a pamphlet.
So, wanna challenge the Skirmish Zone?
Knock ’em dead, Chump.
You’ve already challenged this zone.
What are you trying to pull?
1. You may only challenge each Skimish
Zone once. Once you exit the zone,
defeat the boss, or white out, your
challenge is over.
2. Each trainer you defeat in a zone
grants 2BP, and the boss grants 10BP.
Whiting out forfeits all BP for the zone,
but you may leave at any time and keep
the BP you have accumulated.
3.There will be 5 zones across the
region, each granting 30BP, for a
total of 150BP.r
BP can be spent at any Pokémart.
Choose how you spend it wisely.
4. While in a Skirmish Zone, you will be
unable to access the PC to change your
party. The Pokévial will still be usable.
5. Once you defeat the next Gym Leader,
the Skirmish Zone will be closed and the
area will return to it’s natural state.
